title: UPSSSC PET 2021 Certificate
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
postName: Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2021 – Certificate / Score Card
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open PET 2021 score / certificate
3. Enter registration number and DOB
4. Download score card
5. Use within validity for recruitments
shortDescription: UPSSSC PET 2021 Certificate / score card download from upsssc.gov.in.
content:
UPSSSC PET 2021 scores were issued for eligibility in subsequent commission exams.

Download the score card from upsssc.gov.in and check the validity mentioned in later advertisements before applying.
